description.zh-CN: 专门用来验图标的包：扩展包卡片上那枚来自本目录的 icon.png，页面里的 26 枚图标也全部从 icons/ 现读现画。把整个文件夹拖进设置页 → 扩展包，就能一次验完拖拽安装和图标显示。
description.en: A pack for checking icons: the card icon is this folder's icon.png and all 26 tiles are read from icons/ at runtime. Drag the folder onto Settings > Extensions to test install.
